QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` on, both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `_FREE_MACRO` set | your macros, as compile-time aliases" and "Option A, compile time" vs "Option B, runtime ... `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. Its table only implies that the pointer path applies when "no macros" are set.
